items.title: Mt. Hood National Forest Christmas tree permit
items.action: Buy this year's $5 permits on Recreation.gov (limit five per household) and print yours; digital copies aren't accepted.
items.why: A permit-tracking site reports the 2026 permits on sale now with cutting Nov 12 to Dec 31; the Forest Service's own page hadn't been updated for 2026 when checked, so confirm dates on Recreation.gov.

sources.name: More Than Just Parks permit tracker

items.title: ZooLights at the Oregon Zoo (Nov 20 to Jan 3)
items.action: Open now; buy dated tickets ahead. Prices range $13 to $35 by night, and Any Night tickets work Nov 20 to Dec 31.
items.why: Tickets are sold in advance online and price varies by date, so earlier and weeknight picks are cheaper.

items.title: Christmas Mountain U-cut trees, Scappoose (opens Nov 21)
items.action: Plan a U-cut trip from Nov 21; noble, Nordmann, Douglas and grand fir.
items.why: The farm posted that it opens for the 2026 season on Saturday, Nov 21.

items.title: Blazers vs. Warriors on Black Friday, Moda Center (Nov 27)
items.action: Get seats early for the 6:30 p.m. tip-off.
items.why: KATU picks the Black Friday Warriors visit as one of the marquee home games on the 2026-27 schedule.

items.title: Grotto Christmas Festival of Lights (Nov 27 to Dec 30)
items.action: Buy timed entry online ahead; general admission (12+) is $17.95 online, 5 to 9:30 p.m. nightly.
items.why: The Grotto's own page lists Nov 27 to Dec 30 (closed Christmas Day) with tickets sold through its site.

sources.name: The Grotto Christmas Festival of Lights

items.title: Holiday Express steam train, Oregon Rail Heritage Center (Nov 27 to Dec 27)
items.action: Book a dated ride on orhf.org now; adults $35, kids 3 to 13 $25, under 3 free on a lap, family pass $105.
items.why: The rail center's FAQ says many trains sell out and urges buying in advance, and Travel Portland says tickets are limited and sell out quickly.

sources.name: Oregon Rail Heritage Center: Holiday Express

items.title: Timbers vs. FC Dallas, MLS Cup Playoffs Round One Game 2 (Nov 28)
items.action: Game 1 is at FC Dallas Sat Nov 21 at 1 p.m.; get tickets on timbers.com for the Nov 28, 7:30 p.m. home match at Providence Park.
items.why: Portland's only home game of the best-of-three series; KPTV reported season ticket holders got first access, then the general public at 2 p.m. on the Monday sale day.

items.title: Timberline Mt. Hood Fusion Pass last day to buy (Nov 29)
items.action: Buy a Fusion Pass by Sun, Nov 29; Timberline's page says it isn't sold after that.
items.why: Timberline's season pass page says Fusion Passes are only available through Nov. 29, and Freeskier reports prices rise the longer you wait.

items.title: Topaz Farm holiday market and trees, Sauvie Island (from Nov 29)
items.action: Plan a tree trip on Sauvie Island; Santa visits on weekends Nov 28 to Dec 13.
items.why: Event listings put the holiday market and tree sales opening the weekend after Thanksgiving; the farm's own page describes fresh-cut noble and Douglas firs (not U-cut) and Santa photos on weekends but doesn't post 2026 dates, so check before going.

items.title: Kann: January reservations
items.action: Book on Resy Dec 1 at noon, when the next month's tables are released.
items.why: Kann's FAQ says it releases one month of reservations on the 1st of the prior month at noon; confirm the schedule is still current.

items.title: Christmas Ships viewing dinner
items.action: Check the 2026 route schedule, then reserve a riverside window table for a night the fleet passes.
items.why: The official site says the 2026 schedule is posted, and a festival listing puts the parades Dec 3 to 20; Vancouver's tourism office advises reserving waterfront seats well in advance (Vancouver nights listed Dec 16 to 18).

items.title: Oregon Ballet Theatre: Balanchine's The Nutcracker (Dec 5 to 24)
items.action: Single tickets are on sale from OBT; buy direct for face value rather than resale.
items.why: Runs at Keller Auditorium Dec 5 to 24, with a noon show on Christmas Eve.

items.title: Barnes & Noble Criterion 50% off sale (through Dec 6)
items.action: Buy Criterion 4K wish-list titles now, online or in store; the sale ends Dec 6.
items.why: Criterion says all in-stock discs are half off at B&N through Dec 6; B&N notes it doesn't combine with the Premium Member discount.

items.title: Epic Pass goes off sale Dec 6
items.action: Buy by Sun, Dec 6 if you want an Epic Pass this season; after that it isn't sold for 2026/27.
items.why: Vail Resorts' Nov 16 release says Dec 6 is the last chance to buy an Epic Pass for 2026/27, and OnTheSnow says prices rise until then.

items.title: Ikon Pass final sales window
items.action: Buy by Dec 10 if you want an Ikon Pass this season; check the current price on ikonpass.com.
items.why: Ikon's site gives Dec 10, 2026 as the 26/27 deadline, Powder says prices climb as winter approaches, and last year sales stopped Dec 11.

items.title: Coast state park campsites
items.action: Book Fort Stevens or Nehalem Bay exactly six months before your arrival date on the state's reservation site.
items.why: Oregon State Parks takes reservations up to six months ahead, and Axios reports prime coast spots like Fort Stevens often sell out within minutes; Cape Lookout's campground has been closed for improvements since Aug 3, 2026.

sources.name: Axios Portland: summer permits book fast

items.title: Sylvan Esso, Crystal Ballroom (Feb 22 and 23, 2027)
items.action: Tickets are on sale now; buy face value through the venue's ticketing for either night before the ballroom shows sell through.
items.why: Two Portland nights on the band's 2026-27 tour; the Portland on-sale date wasn't confirmed in the sources found.

items.title: CHVRCHES, Revolution Hall (Mar 8, 2027)
items.action: Artist presale began Oct 27; check Revolution Hall for remaining tickets before the small room sells through.
items.why: New album All the King's Men and a 2027 North American tour; the North American general on-sale date wasn't confirmed in the sources found.

items.title: Queens of the Stone Age with Pixies, Moda Center (May 9, 2027)
items.action: General sale opened Thu Oct 29 at 10 a.m.; buy face value through Live Nation rather than resale.
items.why: Perfecth World Tour with Pixies and Portland's Wheelchair Sports Camp opening; artist presales ran Oct 27 and 28.

items.title: Oregon Sno-Park permit (required Nov 1 to Apr 30)
items.action: Buy an annual permit online from Oregon DMV or a local vendor before your first Mt. Hood snow trip; they aren't sold at the Sno-Parks.
items.why: The Forest Service says permits are required at designated Sno-Parks Nov 1 through Apr 30, and Oregon DMV sells annual permits online Oct 1 through Apr 15 with a printable two-week interim permit.

items.title: DIIV, Revolution Hall (May 12, 2027)
items.action: General sale opened Fri Oct 30 at 10 a.m.; buy face value through Revolution Hall's ticketing before the room sells through.
items.why: Newly announced stop on the ZIRP! world tour, with new single "Dare Me"; no Portland presale details were found in the sources.

items.title: Conversations With Nick Cave, Arlene Schnitzer Concert Hall (Apr 12, 2027)
items.action: General sale opened Fri, Nov 13 at 10 a.m.; buy face value through the official links at nickcave.com rather than resale.
items.why: One of only five North American dates on his 2027 talk-and-piano tour; presale registration ran Nov 11 to 12.

items.title: Mt. Hood Meadows season pass
items.action: If you want a Meadows pass, buy soon; the price climbs as the season nears and sales eventually close.
items.why: Meadows' FAQ says season passes are dynamically priced and rise as the season approaches; check the live price on skihood.com.
